function.name: read
function.description: Read a file or list the contents of a directory. For files, returns the text contents. For directories, returns the names and types of entries.

path.description: Path to the file or directory to read.

function.name: write
function.description: Write text content to a file.

path.description: Path of the file to write.

content.description: Text content to write to the file.

function.name: exec
function.description: Execute a shell command and return its output.
